fieldValues.title: SRS operations covers using, running and repairing SRS
fieldValues.decision_question: What does the SRS operations domain cover?
fieldValues.context: D1 of clerk#57 (plans/wg-srs-operations.md, section 8), asked of the owner since 2026-10-12. Recorded as a proposed decision on 2026-10-16 so a session can take it: until now it existed only as PR text, which no session agenda reads.
fieldValues.decision_statement: SRS operations covers how we use, run and repair SRS in our own work, not what the spec should mean.
fieldValues.rationale: Friction found while using the tools has no home: Semantic records covers what the spec means, and Programme coordination excludes the products (proposal sections 1 and 2).
fieldValues.revisit_when: A request is placed in it that its scope cannot judge.
